items.q: Can I try them at home before I decide?

a.p: Live with them for 100 nights. Move them around, play your own records, have friends over. If they are not for you, we collect them and refund every cent, delivery included.

items.q: What if they don’t suit my room?

a.p: Most rooms are fixed by placement, not by returning. Try this first, then decide.

Each A2 has its own 2 × 60 W amplifier, tuned to its drivers. Plug in power and a source: streaming over Wi-Fi, HDMI from the TV, or analogue in.

items.q: Will they work with my turntable?

a.p: Switch the input on the back to **Phono MM** and connect the turntable directly, ground wire included. A moving-coil cartridge needs its own step-up.
